title: Safari Adds scrollend Event Support, Completing Baseline Browser Coverage
partialText: <img src="https://res.infoq.com/news/2026/04/safari-scrollend-support/en/headerimage/generatedHeaderImage-1775736557972.jpg"/><p>Safari's release of version 26.2 in December introduced support for the scrollend event, completing its alignment with major browsers. This event signals when scrolling has definitively ended, enabling more reliable interactions without the need for workarounds. It improves performance for developers managing UI updates and data fetching based on scroll completion.</p> <i>By Daniel Curtis</i>

title: Tailwind CSS 4.2 Ships Webpack Plugin, New Palettes and Logical Property Utilities
partialText: <img src="https://res.infoq.com/news/2026/04/tailwind-css-4-2-webpack/en/headerimage/generatedHeaderImage-1775645510087.jpg"/><p>Tailwind CSS version 4.2.0, released on February 18, 2026, includes a webpack plugin for streamlined integration and four new color palettes. It expands logical property utilities and improves recompilation speed by 3.8x. This update is particularly beneficial for teams on existing projects and those developing multilingual applications.</p> <i>By Daniel Curtis</i>

title: Module Federation 2.0 Reaches Stable Release with Wider Support outside of Webpack
partialText: <img src="https://res.infoq.com/news/2026/04/module-federation-2-stable/en/headerimage/generatedHeaderImage-1774870811998.jpg"/><p>Module Federation 2.0, an open-source micro-frontend mechanism introduced with webpack 5, offers significant updates including dynamic TypeScript type hints, decoupled runtime layers, and Node.js support. It enhances compatibility across various bundlers and frameworks. Key features include a Side Effect Scanner and easier integration for remote modules, addressing previous adoption challenges.</p> <i>By Daniel Curtis</i>

title: ESLint v10: Flat Config Completion and JSX Tracking
partialText: <img src="https://res.infoq.com/news/2026/04/eslint-10-release/en/headerimage/generatedHeaderImage-1774868620518.jpg"/><p>ESLint version 10 has removed the legacy eslintrc configuration system, finalizing a long transition to flat config. The update enhances developer experience, especially for plugin authors and monorepo teams, by changing configuration file location and improving JSX reference tracking. Node.js support has been tightened, and new assertion options have been added to the RuleTester API.</p> <i>By Daniel Curtis</i>
